comment: PLAN-127 night-shift — reproduces scripts/build-cassetto3-assets.py (R-357 oracle, golden mockup-r357-cassetto-largo.png 1024x1536) as data-only spec. THE hole-bound pilot: the CTA window is a runtime-bound hole — the slicer emits the plaque piece (mask-bearing) + a manifest ctaWindow datum; the primitive clips the live DOM button to the plaque silhouette via CSS mask. Two pieces (cta-plaque, frame-top) are emitted via plugins/cassetto.py — WHY-NOT-SPEC: reconstructive raster rebuild and profile synthesis, not crops.

key.comment: oracle key_black() default — the left rail sits on true-black margin; keyed so the map shows through

geometry.comment: outerRect = whole golden (the column IS the surface, right edge flush with screen). contentRect = live DOM column: paddingLeft = RAIL_W-12 = 88u, so the rail underlaps content by 12px (rimOverlapPx).

holes.comment: Runtime-bound CTA window: DOM button rect in the 1024-design space (right:20, bottom:6, w:880, h:186 = HudRealCassetto CTA_W/CTA_H). maskRef = the plaque piece's alpha — the primitive mask-images the DOM element to the brass silhouette. marginPx 14 = true min clearance (chest crop ends y1330) — the 'generous transparent margin' PLAN-127 requires is validated, not painted.

slices.comment: oracle rail-top — left rail cap (kept as ornament so edgeThickness stays the tile's, not the cap's)
oracle rail-mid — the left rail repeat-y tile (raw crop; oracle does NOT wrap-blend it — seam ratio is oracle-intrinsic)

plugin.comment: WHY-NOT-SPEC: the golden's north is only a floating hairline; the bar is SYNTHESISED from rail-mid's gold cross-section (median profile + seeded noise + hairline) — procedural generation, no crop. NOT regraded (oracle saves it ungraded: its profile is read from the already-graded rail-mid piece — ordering dependency: rail-mid must emit first).

slices.comment: oracle vignette — plain RGB crop of the quest painting, flush right; no key, saved RGB

oracle medal(skull): luma key + MinFilter + blur, then min(max(core, alpha), wide) elliptical window — inside the 0.9 core everything stays (dark reds are part of the skull), outside only bright pixels inside the wide ellipse
oracle medal(chest) — same mask pipeline, tighter 0.58 core

plugin.comment: WHY-NOT-SPEC: oracle rebuilds the button by cv2 inpaint of the baked CONFIRM label, emerald symmetry-axis detection, right-half mirror, 2x upscale + denoise + unsharp, connected-component outside-key — reconstruction, not a crop

slices.comment: The mask-bearing piece for the cta-window hole: its alpha IS the CSS mask the primitive applies to the live DOM button
oracle supply-bag — separate Gemini-generated icon source (per-slice source override), keyed, alpha-cropped, squared, resized
